title: harness-explorer-seed
responsibility: Adds to the synthetic history what the explorer acceptance needs: a page with nested components, a config, and scenarios that record screenshots and end-to-end results.

inputs.name: seedExplorer.repo
inputs.description: The VerifyRepo handle that is the only way seedExplorer touches the repository: its write method for the sources, scripts/explorer.mjs and the scenario files, its harness method for two `harness units index --write` runs, and its json method to read the config unit spec before it is rewritten with write. The seed does not check the handle, so a missing handle or method only fails when the call that needs it runs.

outputs.name: explorerBranch
outputs.description: The branch name 'explorer/tip', which the source comment describes as a branch whose tip is a verified commit. A caller that puts it into an address has to encode the slash, and seedExplorer never uses it.

outputs.name: explorerUnits
outputs.description: The unit ids of the explorer fixture under the keys page, list, row, slugify, config and service. seedExplorer's scenarios use list and row (titles-list) and slugify (slugify-run), the seed uses config to locate the config unit spec, and nothing in this module reads page or service.

outputs.name: seedExplorer
outputs.description: The promise that seedExplorer returns, which resolves with no value only after the config spec has been rewritten and the second `harness units index --write` has finished. It rejects if one of its repo calls does, and the calls after that one do not run.

errors.name: VerifyRepo rejection
errors.description: The seed creates no error of its own: seedExplorer has no try/catch, so when repo.write, repo.harness or repo.json rejects, seedExplorer rejects with that same reason and skips the calls after it.
